title: Wrecks carrying liquor, including wine from the 1600s

tellings.quote: We found also one of the oldest wine in the world from 1600. Wow.

plain: The Swedish treasure hunter Dennis Asberg tells Michels that he and his diving partner Peter Lindberg found shipwrecks on the Baltic seabed still carrying liquor. Around 2005, he says, they found "one of the oldest wine in the world," from the 1600s, showing how well the cold Baltic keeps what sinks into it.
